stats.text:
A new page appears in your *Book of Shadows* when you conjure it. With your permission, a creature can take an action to write its name on that page, which can contain a number of names equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one name).

When any creature whose name is on the page is reduced to 0 {ref:glossary/hit-points} but not killed outright, the creature magically drops to 1 Hit Point instead. Once this magic is triggered, no creature can benefit from it until you finish a {ref:glossary/long-rest}.

As a {ref:glossary/magic} action, you can erase a name on the page by touching it.
